name: Pi Agent Platform Docs
description: piagent-setup installs the pinned Pi Coding Agent host, installs the Pi package, initializes the current directory, and runs doctor. It also installs the MCP baseline and subagents; skip them with --no-mcp, --no-subagents, or --global-only.
